title: Page 3
content_zh:
话说，他的正主子天信集团总裁掌尚智大人，平日工作严肃到令他这个特助常喘不过气，好不容易总裁大人愿意度个假，他稍稍松了一口气之余，却觉得成日跟着嘻嘻哈哈的二少工作，反而有些不习惯。
不过，二少虽然总是不正经，成日一副吊儿郎当样，可是，很多工作都能顺利完成，这点真是令他很疑惑，也很佩服。
“刚刚我大哥说的，你有没有记录下来？”坐上总裁专属座位，掌尚仁难得摆出严肃的架子。“没有的话，自己扣薪。”
“二少，我全记下来了。”
“真的还假的？”他大哥说得一长串落落长，每个子公司都给它关切到，只差没要他去拜访扫地的欧巴桑，这么多如牛毛的事，他就不信左金能全部记下来。“拿来给我看。”
“是，二少。”
左金点给掌尚仁看。
大略浏览过后，掌尚仁呆愣一秒，叹了声，旋即以同情的口吻道：“左金，你真的被我大哥操得有够厉害，这……这简直是一字不漏的纪录。有没有必要这么累啊，记重点就行了，干么连……这什么？郭董夫人生日，买一个手工包送给她？不要买名牌包？我大哥什么时候连这种事也管？而且我怎么没印象他有说这段话？”
“总裁说这段话时，二少你正好弯身捡笔，而且……捡很久。”
“是吗？”对啦，他是有藉弯身捡笔时，偷偷休息一下下，视讯讨论那么久，是人都会累的好不好！没当场趴在桌上睡觉，算是念在他和大哥当了二十八年的兄弟份上，给足大哥面子。
左金点点头。“这个是大少奶奶交代的，因为郭董夫人是她进入‘上流圈’交的第一个好朋友，所以她很重视。”
“喔，不错嘛，我大嫂开始懂得交际了。和那些大公司董事长的夫人培养感情，对我们集团来说，也是有益的。好吧，这件事就交给你去办。”
“我？”
“难不成是我？”掌尚仁斜睨他。
“是。可是，二少，我……”
“这笔钱算公费，不会扣你薪水，不用你出钱。”掌尚仁不知何时已开始敲着键盘，回覆一些重要信件。
“我不知道要去哪里买手工包？”意识到二少开始工作，左金上紧发条，一堆文件中夹着一封信，他随手拿起。
“你不知道，难不成我就知道？”手继续敲打键盘，睨了一直拿手工包这事烦他的傻蛋一眼，掌尚仁又继续他的工作。“你就不会去问公司的女生，秘书、主管、扫地的欧巴桑都好，看是要手工包水饺、手工包包子，还是手工包饭团……不管要什么包，那些女的一定会知无不言、言无不尽的告诉你。”
“呃，二少，大少奶奶说的，应该是手工大包包，不是吃的，是用的。”
“你难道听不出来，方才我是在展现我幽默的一面？”可怜的小金弟弟，跟大哥跟久了，一点幽默风趣都不懂。

“喔，原来是这样，我懂、我懂。”拆了信，抽出一张日历纸和回邮信封，左金愣呆了下，听到二少飞快的敲键盘声，不敢迟疑，他立即照日历纸上的字念着，“尚仁卿卿如晤——”
“那是什么鬼啊？”突然起了一身鸡皮疙瘩，掌尚仁停下打字的动作。“左金，你没看到我正忙吗？干么念信——”
他看到左金手中有信封，和一张……日历纸？哇，节能减碳做得这么彻底，该不该颁给写信的人一个爱护地球的大奖？
“是这样的，二少，因为总裁工作习惯一心多用，通常他在回覆信件时，我都会向他报告今日行程，有实体信，我也会先念给他听。”
意思就是说他大哥很强就是了，好吧，输人不输阵，要一心多用，那可是他的强项，夜会三妹对他而言根本是小？Case。
“二少你如果不习惯，那我等会儿再念信。”
“我没什么好不习惯的，要念你就念，不过，前头那句鬼话就不用再念了。”他猜，肯定是某个对他念念不忘的女人，写了一封缠绵悱恻的信，想要他回心转意。
人啊，长得太帅，爱慕信总是多如牛毛，虽是司空见惯，但听到某些肉麻字句，他还是会忍不住“加冷笋”。
“是。”左金看着信继续念，“与你分别十四年之久，想念之情与日俱增，若我依然在你心深处，那么……那么……那么……”
“左金，你是没收过情书吗？念一封情书，干么还口吃？”
“二少，不是我口吃，是信上这么写的，还写了两三行‘那么……那么……’。”
“你就不知变通，不会跳过那一段。”呆瓜！
“喔。那么……请将你欠我的爱心捐款还给我。”左金顿了下，看了掌尚仁一眼。“二少，你有欠人家钱？”
“欠钱怎么可能，我是谁？”
“天信集团的副总裁，目前是代理总裁。”
“没错，所以我怎么可能欠人家钱？”回覆信件后，掌尚仁起身，伸着懒腰。
“可是信上说，你国小六年级的时候，老师要你每天捐十元投进爱心箱，都是她帮你捐的，还捐了一整个学期——”
“这样啊，听你这么说，好像是有捐钱这么一回事……可是，我不太记得了。”掌尚仁摸着下巴，努力回想。
“她说，过了十四年，那些钱本金加利息，算你十万就好。”
“十万？小数目。”掌尚仁想了想，蹙起眉头，“不对呀，左金你算算，如果一天十元，那一学期要多少？”

“一学期大概有……几天呢？”
“不用麻烦，就算一年好了，一年三百六十五天，每天十元，不过三千六百五十元，她居然想跟我要十万？抢匪啊她！”
“是太多了点，不过她有写说，如果你不还钱的话……”
“他要找讨债集团？还是要报警抓我、或者上法院告我？”掌尚仁一副本少爷没在怕的模样。
“都不是耶，她写说……呃，不还钱的话……”左金期期艾艾，话梗在喉间说不出口。
“怎样？快说。”
“她写说，不……不……不还钱的话，小鸡鸡烂掉。”
闻言，在场的两个大男人，下腹处同时一阵紧缩。
掌尚仁霍地想起国小六年级时，那个娇小的风纪股长兼毒舌派的掌门人，对付爱讲话的男生，总是那一句——再讲话的人，小鸡鸡烂掉。
这句经典恐吓的话语一出，全班小男生鸦雀无声，噤若寒蝉。
她的名字叫做——
“巴瑞儿！”
“宾果！二少，你答对了。”
掌尚仁睨了左金一眼。这有什么好爽的，笨呆瓜！
他想起她来了，这是很不好的预兆，他生命中第一个克星……目前为止，也是唯一的一个。
巴瑞儿，喔，不，老天爷千万不要让他再遇上她。
第2章(1)
拿着掌尚仁“火速”寄来的十万块，缴清房租，巴瑞儿晃到公园傻坐了一个下午。
说火速一点都不为过，在她寄出索讨陈年爱心债的隔天，他就将一张十万块的即期支票，寄到她租用的信箱内。托他的福，她至少有一个月的时间，都不用再花脑筋想一些和房东“呛声”用的台词。
这几个月来她和房东对呛的话，多到可以出一本呛声精选集了。

再怎么滚，也滚不到十万，除非是高利贷的地下钱庄……
content_en:
By the way, his real master, Mr. Zhang Shangzhi, the president of Tianxin Group, was so serious about his daily work that his special assistant was often breathless. Finally, the president was willing to take a vacation. He was slightly relieved, but he felt that working with the cheerful second young master all day long was a bit unaccustomed.
However, although the Second Young Master was always unserious and acted like a fool all day long, he was able to complete many tasks smoothly, which really puzzled and admired him.
"Did you record what my elder brother just said?" Sitting in the CEO's exclusive seat, Zhang Shangren rarely put on a serious air. "If not, I will deduct my salary."
"Second Young Master, I've written it all down."
"Real or false?" His elder brother said a long list, and every subsidiary company was concerned about it, except that he was not asked to visit Obasan who was sweeping the floor. There were so many things that he didn't believe Zuo Jin could write down all. "Show it to me."
"Yes, Second Young Master."
Show the golden dot on the left to Zhang Shangren.
After briefly browsing, Zhang Shangren was stunned for a second, sighed, and then said in a sympathetic tone: "Zuo Jin, you were really fucked hard by my elder brother. This... this is a verbatim record. Is there any need to be so tired? Just remember the key points. Why even... what is this? Buy a handmade bag for Mrs. Guo Dong's birthday? Don't buy a brand-name bag? When did my elder brother even care about such a thing? And why don't I remember that he said this?"
"When the president said this, Second Young Master, you happened to bend down to pick up the pen, and...you took a long time to pick it up."
"Really?" Yes, he took a break secretly when he bent down to pick up a pen. After such a long video discussion, everyone will be tired, okay? He didn't lie down on the table and sleep on the spot, just because he and his eldest brother had been brothers for twenty-eight years, so as to give him face.
Zuo Jin nodded. "The eldest mistress told me this, because Mrs. Guo Dong was the first good friend she made when she entered the 'upper class', so she takes it very seriously."
"Oh, that's good. My sister-in-law is starting to know how to communicate. Cultivating relationships with the wives of the chairman of those big companies is also beneficial to our group. Well, I'll leave this matter to you."
"Me?"
"Could it be me?" Zhang Shangren looked at him sideways.
"Yes. But, Second Young Master, I..."
"This money is considered public money. Your salary will not be deducted and you don't have to pay." Zhang Shangren didn't know when he started typing on the keyboard to reply to some important letters.
"I don't know where to buy handmade bags?" Realizing that the second young master had started to work, Zuo Jin wound up the clockwork. There was a letter sandwiched in a pile of documents, and he picked it up casually.
"You don't know, how could it be possible that I know?" He continued to type on the keyboard, glanced at the fool who had been annoying him about handmade bags, and Zhang Shangren continued his work. "You wouldn't ask the girls in the company, whether it's the secretary, the supervisor, or the sweeper Obasan, whether you want handmade dumplings, handmade buns, or handmade rice balls... No matter what kind of bag you want, those women will definitely tell you everything."
"Well, Second Young Master, what the eldest young lady said should be handmade big bags, not for eating, but for use."
"Can't you hear that I was showing my humorous side just now?" Poor little brother Jin, who has been with his elder brother for so long, doesn't understand any humor at all.
"Oh, that's it, I understand, I understand." After opening the letter and taking out a piece of calendar paper and a return envelope, Zuo Jin was stunned for a moment. Hearing the second young master's rapid typing on the keyboard, he didn't dare to hesitate. He immediately read the words on the calendar paper, "Shang Ren, please meet -"
"What the hell is that?" Goosebumps suddenly appeared all over his body, and Zhang Shangren stopped typing. "Zuo Jin, didn't you see that I was busy? Why are you reading the letter——"
He saw an envelope in Zuo Jin's hand, and a piece of...calendar paper? Wow, we have done such a thorough job of saving energy and reducing carbon emissions. Should we award the person who wrote the letter a prize?A grand prize for caring for the earth?
"That's it, Second Young Master. Because the president is accustomed to multi-tasking at work, usually when he replies to a letter, I will report today's itinerary to him. If there is a physical letter, I will read it to him first."
It means that his eldest brother is very strong. Well, he can't lose even if he loses. He has to multi-task. That's his strength. The third sister of Yehui is simply small to him? Case.
"Second Young Master, if you are not used to it, then I will read the letter later."
"I have nothing to get used to. If you want to miss you, just read it. However, there is no need to read the nonsense sentence in front of it." He guessed that it must be a woman who was obsessed with him and wrote a lingering and pathos letter, hoping that he would change her mind.
He's so handsome, and he always gets a lot of love letters. Although it's commonplace, he still can't help but "add cold bamboo shoots" when he hears some disgusting words.
"Yes." Zuo Jin looked at the letter and continued to read, "I have been separated from you for fourteen years, and the feeling of missing you is getting stronger day by day. If I am still deep in your heart, then... then... then..."
"Zuo Jin, have you never received a love letter? Why are you still stuttering when you read a love letter?"
"Second Young Master, it's not that I stutter, that's what the letter said, and it also included two or three lines of 'then...then...'."
"You don't know how to adapt and skip that section." Idiot!
"Oh. Then...please return the donation you owe me." Zuo Jin paused and glanced at Zhang Shangren. "Second Young Master, do you owe anyone money?"
"How is it possible that I owe money? Who am I?"
"The vice president of Tianxin Group is currently the acting president."
"That's right, so how could I owe someone money?" After replying to the letter, Zhang Shangren stood up and stretched.
"But the letter said that when you were in the sixth grade of elementary school, your teacher asked you to donate ten yuan a day to the charity box. She donated it for you, and she donated it for the whole semester-"
"That's it. From what you said, it seems like there was such a thing as donating money... But, I don't really remember." Zhang Shangren touched his chin and tried to remember.
"She said that after fourteen years, the principal plus interest on that money will be worth one hundred thousand to you."
"One hundred thousand? A small amount." Zhang Shangren thought for a moment and frowned, "No, Zuo Jin, do the math. If it's ten yuan a day, how much will it cost for one semester?"
"How many...how many days does a semester last?"
"Don't bother, even if it's a year, it's 365 days a year, ten yuan a day, but it's only 3,650 yuan. She actually wants to ask me for 100,000? She's a robber!"
"It's a bit too much, but she wrote that if you don't pay back the money..."
"Is he going to find a debt collection group? Or is he going to call the police and arrest me, or go to court to sue me?" Zhang Shangrenyi said as if the young master was not afraid.
"That's not true. She wrote that...well, if she doesn't pay back the money..." Zuo Jin sighed, but the words stuck in his throat and he couldn't say it out.
"How? Tell me quickly."
"She wrote that if she doesn't pay back the money, her penis will rot."
Hearing this, the two big men present felt a contraction in their lower abdomens at the same time.
The palm leader vividly remembered that when he was in the sixth grade of elementary school, the petite chief of the discipline department and the head of the poisonous tongue sect always had the same saying when dealing with boys who liked to talk - those who talk again will have their penises rot.
As soon as these classic threatening words came out, all the little boys in the class fell into silence.
Her name is——
"Barrel!"
"Bingo! Second Young Master, you got the answer right."
Zhang Shangren glanced at Zuo Jin. What's so cool about this, you idiot!
He remembered that she was here, which was a very bad omen, the first nemesis in his life... so far, the only one.
Barrier, oh, no, God must not let him meet her again.
Chapter 2(1)
With the 100,000 yuan "quickly" sent by Zhang Shangren and the rent paid, Barrier wandered to the park and sat there all afternoon.
To say it is fast is not an exaggeration.The day after she sent a demand for her old love debt, he sent a demand check for RMB 100,000 to the mailbox she rented. Thanks to him, she would have at least a month without having to think of lines to "choke" with the landlord.
In the past few months, she has had so many confrontations with her landlord that she could publish a collection of them.
No matter how hard you try, you won’t get more than 100,000, unless it’s an underground bank with high interest rates...
